name: New Swarnima Scheme For Women
benefit: 1. A subsidy amount of ₹ 2,00,000/- @ 5% per annum, for self-employment. (The remaining amount has to be self-owned by the beneficiary.) 1. The beneficiary woman is not required to invest any amount of her own on the projects upto cost of ₹ 2,00,000/-.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a Female. 1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 55 years. 1. The applicant must be an Entrepreneur 1. The Total Annual Family Income of the Applicant must be Less than ₹ 3 Lakh per Annum.
